_readme: Song-agnostic shot list. `nightshift timeline resolve` fits it to the chosen song (shots_resolved.json + cut.json). Fields: see docs/shots.md.

shots.location: a long empty avenue in a city at night, wet asphalt reflecting sodium street lamps and shop signs with no readable text, light mist, completely empty, 24mm wide lens, low angle
shots.video: A wide, low-angle shot of an empty avenue at night. Mist drifts through the lamp light, puddles shiver in the wind. The camera glides slowly forward along the centre line.

shots.expr: calm, lips gently closed, about to sing
shots.action: standing under a street lamp, singing softly, eyes half closed, 85mm lens
shots.location: a long empty avenue in a city at night, wet asphalt reflecting sodium street lamps and shop signs with no readable text, light mist
shots.video: Close-up of {lead} under a street lamp at night, singing softly, the avenue a blur of lights behind her. Handheld camera drifting slowly around her.

shots.action: walking toward the camera down the middle of the avenue, arms loose, 35mm lens
shots.location: a long empty avenue in a city at night, wet asphalt reflecting sodium street lamps and shop signs with no readable text, light mist
shots.video: Medium shot of {lead} walking toward the camera down the middle of a wet avenue at night. The camera tracks backward in front of her, steady.
Aerial drone shot at night rising slowly over a city grid, ribbons of headlights and taillights streaming along the avenues, low clouds glowing orange from below. Smooth, cinematic camera movement.

shots.action: leaning on the rooftop ledge with the skyline behind her, singing, 50mm lens
shots.location: the flat gravel rooftop of an old brick building at night, water tanks, the city skyline glowing behind under low clouds
shots.video: Medium shot of {lead} leaning on a rooftop ledge at night, singing, the skyline glowing behind her. The camera arcs slowly around her.

shots.expr: open, joyful, singing with full voice
shots.action: singing with full voice and arms opening wide under a ring of warm bulbs, 35mm lens
shots.location: a dark rehearsal stage with a ring of warm tungsten bulbs hanging overhead, haze, glossy black floor
shots.video: Medium shot of {lead} on a dark stage under a ring of warm bulbs, singing with full voice, arms opening wide as the bulbs pulse. The camera dollies in fast and swings around her.

shots.action: dancing freely in the centre of the stage, mid-spin with her arms out, small figure under the ring of bulbs, 24mm lens
shots.location: a dark rehearsal stage with a ring of warm tungsten bulbs hanging overhead, haze, glossy black floor
shots.video: Wide shot of {lead} dancing and spinning under a ring of warm bulbs, haze glowing. The camera cranes down and sweeps around her.
A wide, low-angle shot of an empty avenue at night. The mist settles, the lamps hum. The camera drifts slowly backward along the centre line.
